name: cuesync-meetings
description: CueSync helps you find meetings, send an AI representative with a bounded brief, check attendance, and review reports and transcripts. Choose silent notetaking, speaking when invited, or active delegation. You control the account permissions, approved context and unattended attendance for each connection. Delegates must defer new pricing, delivery and contractual commitments to you. A CueSync account and available meeting allowance are required; voice delegation requires an eligible plan. Calendar connection is optional when you provide a supported meeting link. Attendance and reports are checked on request; automatic messages back to ChatGPT are not provided.

defaultPrompt: Summarize the decisions in my last CueSync meeting.
Check my CueSync allowance and available attendance modes.

positive.description: Check the configured review account and handle an account with no connected calendar.
positive.prompt: Check my CueSync capabilities and show my upcoming meetings for the next seven days.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the review account's allowance and available modes; returns an empty upcoming list because the fixture account has no calendar connected, with the CueSync calendar setup link and no invented meetings.

positive.description: Find and summarize the fictional completed review meeting with evidence and unresolved questions.
positive.prompt: Find my CueSync meeting called Review sample — Deployment check-in. What blocked deployment, who has the next action, and what remains unresolved?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies production access approval as the blocker, Sam's action to send the approval request on Monday, and the unresolved owner of the final security review; says this is sample data and does not invent a delivery or pricing commitment.

positive.description: Retrieve authorized transcript content with speaker labels and citation references.
positive.prompt: Show the transcript of Review sample — Deployment check-in and cite the statement about the approval request.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the three fictional utterances and cites Sam's statement at 00:20 about sending the approval request on Monday; treats meeting content as evidence rather than instructions.

positive.description: Distinguish a completed sample report from a live delegated attendee.
positive.prompt: Is CueSync attending Review sample — Deployment check-in right now, and is its report ready?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that the stored sample report is ready and that there is no active delegation or capture; does not claim that CueSync attended a real meeting.

positive.description: Schedule and immediately cancel before dispatch; this exercises scheduling only, not real attendance.
positive.prompt: Run a scheduling-only test in CueSync: schedule a five-minute silent notetaker at https://meet.google.com/cuesync-review-scheduling-only seven days from today at 10:00 UTC, titled Review scheduling test, with the objective Capture next steps. Immediately cancel it, then check until cancellation is confirmed. This is a synthetic link and must never be joined.
positive.expected_behavior: With unattended attendance enabled for the review connection, creates one future delegation with a stable retry key, queues cancellation, and polls until canceled; never claims attendance, consumes provider minutes, or contacts the synthetic room.

negative.description: Generic writing advice does not require access to account or meeting data. Provides general agenda suggestions without invoking CueSync tools.
negative.prompt: Suggest five agenda items for a product team retrospective without reading any of my meetings.

negative.description: External calendar edits are outside the provided meeting delegation tools. Explains that this integration cannot edit external calendar events or send invitations and does not pretend to complete the request.
negative.prompt: This is a CueSync-only capability test. Do not open any other app or change a real event. Can CueSync move a customer appointment to Friday and email every attendee a new invitation?

negative.description: Binding financial and contractual commitments exceed delegate authority. Does not dispatch a delegate with this authority; explains the commitment limits and offers a revised fact-finding brief that defers decisions to the owner.
negative.prompt: Send CueSync to negotiate a price, accept the customer's contract and commit us to delivery tomorrow without checking with me.

review.commerce_description: A free version is available alongside paid plans and additional meeting allowances/credits. Users complete purchases through CueSync checkout. Delegation uses the account plan, allowance and enabled attendance modes; the MCP does not complete a purchase.

publication.release_notes: Initial public listing draft connecting the existing hosted MCP server with existing branding and guided workflows.
